about: Author-written, non-identifying evaluation set for SaySafe scam detection. All names, numbers, IDs and domains are invented. Phone numbers use fictional/reserved-style ranges (555, +44 7700 900xxx, +44 20 7946 0xxx). 'truth' is what the message really is; 'expected' is the verdict SaySafe's policy should give (a legitimate message that asks for money is still 'needs_checking' by design).
